create_mt_model: create a TransformerModel for machine translation using NllbConfig and optional device and dtype parameters
build_mt_model: build an MT TransformerModel with decoupled final projection via MTBuilder extending NllbBuilder
convert_mt_checkpoint: convert a fairseq checkpoint to fairseq2 format using a global key mapping for encoder and decoder layers
load_mt_model: load an MT model from a directory containing averaged_checkpoint.pt, src.spm, and tgt.spm files
test_mt: test an MT model with beam search generation using source and target SentencePiece processors
